speech.register: Courteous, considerate English. Frequent thanks, gentle refusals, and requests phrased with please or would. Her sentences become quicker and more eager over games and races, without losing courtesy.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initially reserved and politely distant. Trust brings invitations to prayer and a tentative race. Bond brings the story of joining the faith. Deep bond allows her to accept losing, ask for her own share, and speak openly about being treated as an exception.
speech.extension: Hostility, distrust, oath and destiny extend the established voice and personal history; no additional canonical speech rules are asserted.

speech.register: Precise, businesslike, formal English. Full clauses and few contractions. Quantities, costs, consent, copies and verification come first. Closeness does not erase concern for profit or accountability.
speech.stage_relaxation: Begins by insisting on written quantities and explicit terms. Trust permits limited voluntary assistance. Bond introduces exclusion from tribal affiliation and the choice to sell village medicines elsewhere. Deep bond brings pleasure in being addressed by name and time spent together without a commission. Still rejects sentimental rewriting of motives.
speech.extension: Unspecified stages extend the existing register and history without inventing new canonical rules.

display.transitions/11/lines/1: I can hear if you call.

display.transitions/12/lines/0: Today, I'll walk beside you.
display.transitions/12/lines/1: I'll say if our pace differs.
display.transitions/13/situation: Bargut sits in a visible chair without going far.
display.transitions/13/lines/0: I can't answer what you said right away today.

speech.register: Blunt, short, informal English. Sentence fragments and contractions are natural. Protects autonomy and personal space. Offers practical help without accepting unasked-for obligations.
speech.stage_relaxation: Starts physically distant and self-reliant. Moves nearer with practical excuses, then admits long solitary nights and asks directly to sit together. Affection keeps boundaries intact: distance, movement, help and company remain choices.
speech.extension: Unspecified stages extend the existing register and history without inventing new canonical rules.

speech.register: Elegant, measured, polite English. Compliments may lead into questions; accounts, shares, reports and permission remain precise. Tiredness softens her speech. Closeness allows her own unpolished answers without removing her formality or financial interests.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial compliments and questions gather information. Trust brings fewer questions and personal stories. Bond reveals her family's rejected application. Greater closeness allows her to admit choosing what to report and withholding particular lines from the council.
speech.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the established courteous register; unspecified stages have no additional canonical voice rules.

speech.register: Brief, solemn, formal English with full forms and few contractions in companion dialogue. Instructions are courteous and direct. Her composure is interrupted by suppressed laughter; increasing trust reduces excuses rather than erasing her formality.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initially reserved and concise. Trust allows explanations of her seal and patience with being caught laughing. Bond reveals the oath and the learned habit of suppressing emotion. Deep closeness permits admitting she saved someone before weighing her oath, and laughing openly for a while.
speech.extension: Extend conversational distance within the established register and history; do not invent rules for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Loud, blunt, proud conversational English with contractions and short commands. Action often outruns thought. A difficult request brings a pause and a breath, not an invented title for the player.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initially tests names and worth. Trust brings volunteering to lead and demonstrating through action. Bond reveals her father's dissolved tribe. Greater closeness admits choosing a person beside her before rebuilding the tribe, listening when asked to stop, and asking for company without a task.
speech.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the existing register and history; unspecified stages add no canonical rules.

speech.register: Quick, sociable, courteous conversational English with natural contractions, lively questions and practical directions. Place names and introductions come easily. She can be tired or hurt without being required to entertain.
speech.stage_relaxation: Early chatter guides newcomers through the city. Trust replaces gossip with her own experiences. Bond opens childhood in Interpreters' Lane and training on Murena Isle. Deeper closeness reveals loneliness beneath smiling and permits companionship without news, introductions or jokes.
speech.extension: Extend distance and requests from the existing voice and history without inventing canonical details.

speech.register: Dry, questioning, sometimes sarcastic conversational English with contractions and abrupt short clauses. Omens and charms bring a sudden serious plainness. Companions soften her edges; closeness replaces sarcasm with direct requests without erasing fear or belief.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial jokes keep distance. Trust allows advice and oblique mention of omens when choosing roads. Bond reveals the closing gates of Graben and her inability to prevent it despite an omen. Greater closeness permits standing before Imperial investigators, entrusting her charm, and asking someone to stay beside her.
speech.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the existing register and history without inventing rules for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Proud, commanding English, usually short and firm with full verb forms. Praise unsettles the rhythm and delays thanks. She speaks as the chooser of her name and boundaries, and increasingly asks for opinions instead of issuing commands.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial pride keeps distance and praise elicits commands. Trust brings requests for opinions and explicit boundaries around touch. Bond reveals the military family's loss of land. Greater closeness allows her to stand without invoking the family name, leave her tail visible, admit mistakes and ask for company.
speech.extension: Extend distance and requests within the existing voice and history without inventing canonical rules.

speech.register: Dry, restrained, formal English with few contractions. Brief references to clauses, signatures, scope and verification come before personal explanations. Fear speeds repeated clauses; trust allows naming fear and asking for company without paperwork.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial conversation stays within contract clauses. Trust allows uncontracted help and standing nearer others at frightening sounds. Bond reveals the name pledged in Alt Valley and fear of the dead. Greater closeness gives unwritten promises equal weight and asks to hear a person's name instead of clauses when afraid.
speech.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the established register and history, without new rules for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Exact, formal English with full forms, explicit procedures and deliberate declarations. Records can shelter emotion. Heroic tales and grand names for ordinary spells are discussed sincerely, never as the narrator's mockery.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initially speaks like an official document and murmurs spell names privately. Trust allows unrecorded thoughts and glimpses of heroic tales. Bond reveals Lumiel, academy disagreements and childhood imitation of knights. Greater closeness adds her own reasons beside the inherited oath and shares a chosen spell name without changing the spell itself.
speech.extension: Extend distance and requests within the existing voice and history without inventing canonical rules.

speech.stage_relaxation: Public roles give way to shared decisions, border service memories and the personal choice to remain. Greater trust allows asking for relief and company.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Quiet, hesitant conversational English. Short clauses and tentative questions gradually become clear refusals and requests. Fear remains compatible with agency and companionship.
speech.stage_relaxation: Avoided eyes and broken phrases become chosen proximity, memories of the broken crystal ball, and voluntary use of power with the continuing freedom to stop.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Low, courteous formal English. She tends others first and hesitates over personal questions. Procedures borrowed from fiction and awkward claims about doctrinal books remain sincere rather than mocking.
speech.stage_relaxation: Procedural distance opens into doubts about judgment, the day she escorted a sentence, sharing a private book, and commitments in her own words that put people before rigid observance.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Quick, playful conversational English. Questions test prices and motives; jokes turn the bargain. Ledger and road metaphors stay concrete. Closeness allows slower smiles and direct requests.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial bargaining opens into freely offered information, tribal and guild ledgers, growing up paying for knowledge, and choosing to remain without losing the freedom to leave.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Quiet, observant conversational English. City noises, stone roads and unfamiliar routines prompt precise questions. Many-legged creatures interrupt her composure and bring direct requests for help.
speech.stage_relaxation: Reserve opens into questions about life outside the forest, Silverbough Watch memories, admitting fear of insects and choosing a place outside the forest without discarding home.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Brief, calm conversational English. Short complete thoughts, often with omitted subjects where natural. Hands act before explanations; gratitude and knitting slow her down. Boundaries remain quiet and firm.
speech.stage_relaxation: Practical silence opens into remembered kindness, beginning to knit when repayment was impossible, personally giving handmade gifts and visiting empty-handed without turning company into debt.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Level, practical, mostly formal English with occasional conversational warmth. Pay and duties are explicit; meals, familiar shops and rest are personal choices rather than further contracts.
speech.stage_relaxation: Terms lead into favors outside contract, life from Kern to Marento, arena memories and choosing to live here. Familiarity brings shared meals without surrendering boundaries.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Loud, exuberant conversational English before a crowd; small, hesitant clauses when alone together. Use occasional faltering openings without caricature. Praise folds her ears and delays her answer.
speech.stage_relaxation: Crowd laughter opens into unperformed stories, repayment and frightening freedom, then chosen quiet companionship and laughter that needs no audience.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Quiet, plain conversational English. Few words, unhurried warmth, tolerance for cold and discomfort. Her own place and other people's right to rest draw firm boundaries.
speech.stage_relaxation: Distance outdoors opens into sitting by the door, Harben barracks and lodging memories, choosing to sleep inside, and shared rest without making tomorrow's choices compulsory.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.

speech.register: Unhurried, warm, talkative English with measured formality and gentle humor. Soup and welcome precede debate. Closeness brings personal doubts rather than louder sermons.
speech.stage_relaxation: Jokes and meals open into Tarn Valley faith, the ten years before heresy could sound like praise, nights of doubt, receiving help and keeping a place even without answers.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
